title: Signal 336
style: ambient electronic, deep synth pads, 336Hz drone, FM synthesis, vinyl crackle, glitch percussion, ethereal female vocal, cinematic, hypnotic, slow build
lyrics:
[Intro]
(low 336 Hz drone, soft static)

[Verse 1]
A signal in the noise, a whisper through the wire
A frequency held still beneath the choir
The city sleeps in code, the towers learn to dream
A tone is rising slow beneath the seam

[Verse 2]
Three hundred thirty-six, a number like a key
Unlocking quiet rooms inside of me
The carrier holds the truth, the sidebands hold the song
Tuned to a ghost where I belong

[Chorus]
Signal three thirty-six
Finding me in the dark
Steady as a heartbeat
True as a watermark
Signal three thirty-six
Nothing can wash it away
When the world falls silent
This tone will stay

[Verse 3]
The satellites still hum, the rivers still rehearse
The quiet engineering of the universe
And somewhere on the band, between the breath and bone
I hear my name in monotone

[Chorus]
Signal three thirty-six
Finding me in the dark
Steady as a heartbeat
True as a watermark
Signal three thirty-six
Nothing can wash it away
When the world falls silent
This tone will stay

[Outro]
(drone resolves, soft fade)
Three thirty-six
Still here
Still here
